read_only_window_identity.limit: These fresh App instances expose AXWindow in the background, unlike the earlier standard-window instance that returned AXApplication. This disproves a universal background AX limitation on this host; process, timing or registration cause of the earlier observation remains unresolved. The SPI mapping succeeds in this controlled sample but is not a documented cross-provider public contract.

fixture_crash_diagnostic.first_foreground_attempt: two fixture processes aborted in their own deferred event logger after activation mouse events; neither submit callback fired; returned user_interrupted cannot be counted as human takeover
fixture_crash_diagnostic.stack: SIGABRT, NSJSONSerialization _writeJSONNumber -> Fixture.record -> deferred FixtureWindow.sendEvent sink
fixture_crash_diagnostic.root_cause_supported_by_fixed_run: activation mouse events had nonfinite location; fixed logger marks location_valid=false and does not serialize NaN/Inf; both repaired Apps survived subsequent real input
